description: "Hand-Book of Practical Cookery, for Ladies and Professional Cooks" by Pierre Blot is a culinary guide written in the late 19th century. This comprehensive work aims to instruct readers in the art and science of cooking, providing practical advice and numerous recipes suitable for both novice housekeepers and professional cooks.
